offering_description.value: Distributes electronic components and hardware to original equipment manufacturers, contract manufacturers and wholesale distributors. It supports manufacturers’ production with services such as custom packaging, bin stocking, kitting and assembly.

quotes.quote: bisco primarily sells product to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and contract manufacturers (CMs). bisco’s sells a wide range of products with a strong focus on Aerospace and Defense hardware, commercial hardware, electro-mechanical hardware, access hardware, fasteners, and electronic components. bisco also provides customized services and solutions for a range of production needs, including special packaging, bin stocking, kitting and assembly, bar coding, electronic requisitioning, and integrated supply programs, among others.

Fast-Cor is the distributor’s source for electronic components and hardware. For over 60 years Fast-Cor has focused on servicing wholesale distributors of electronic components and hardware. As specialist in working with other B2B distributors, Fast-Cor has built out a suite of value added services specific to supporting this fast-pace high volume industry.

(bisco) and bisco’s wholly-owned Canadian subsidiary, Bisco Industries Limited (collectively, the Company). The Company engages in the distribution of electronic components and hardware through its multiple primary divisions: bisco, National-Precision and Fast-Cor.
